summary: Line-by-line parser for .SVM/.HDV vehicle configuration files. Opens the file in binary-read mode, runs an optional first-pass format check that rejects files with no recognized section header, then iterates lines and dispatches each section (General, FrontWing, LeftFender, RightFender, RearWing, BodyAero, Diffuser, Suspension, Controls, Engine, Driveline, per-wheel corners, Basic) to a section-specific reader. Token readers (int/float/string/bool) populate the internal vehicle setup struct (this) and normalize range/setting pairs into the output vehicle state struct (a3); several sections resolve and parse secondary files (damage model, engine, gear file) relative to the config path. Ends with track-config finalization and stream cleanup.

local_names.a2: vehicle config file path (path base for FileFinder sub-file resolution)
local_names.a4: flags: bit0 first-pass format check, bit2 parse sub-files vs path-only
local_names.v57: resolved sub-file path buffer (first slot), -1 sentinel (second slot)
local_names.v54: count of gear settings actually parsed
local_names.v56: saved file handle across section dispatch

operations.description: Open the config file in binary-read mode ("rb") via sub_534B00; if the handle is null, free the pending path buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf and return -1.

First-pass format validation (a4 bit 0): scan for the '=' delimiter (sub_589DB0) and require at least one recognized section header among Setting/Notes/Downforce/Balance/Ride/Gearing/Custom/Symmetric (sub_587C20). If none found and this is not a server session (dword_7C569C != 5), write the "%s is an illegal .SVM file" message via StringSplitLoop/DebugLogWrite into dword_8AD25C, then rewind the stream with AudioStreamBufferRead, close it via StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch, free the path buffer and abort.

Main parse loop: read the next line with LineInputReader, decode its token type with sub_5651B0 (0=data line, 1=end-of-section, else stop), then match the section header with sub_587C20 and dispatch to the matching section parser.

General section: read scalar/vector settings (Rules, GarageDisplayFlags, FeelerFlags, Mass, Inertia, CgHeight, WedgePushrod, GraphicalOffsets, the four Undertrays, FuelTankPos/Motion, AI aid/performance scalars, Notes, Symmetric) with the int/float/string token readers into this-relative fields; mirror selected values into the output struct (a3+6544 Rules, a3+6540 garage-display, a3+6556 wedge-pushrod, a3+6565 symmetric). Rules also lands at this+0x34, garage-display at this+0x38, wedge-pushrod copied from this+0x68; Notes goes through sub_5665B0.

General section, tire brand: parse TireBrand, strip the filename extension, copy the brand into the output vehicle name via NameStringCopy, then look it up with TireBrandLookup(&dword_8AD254); on success copy the compound's data into the output struct and write the this+0x8 tire-compound RPM multiplier; on an unknown brand, in non-server sessions, emit "*.hdv file references unknown tire compound" via StringSplitLoop/DebugLogWrite. Missing compound path falls back to byte_5EA438 before StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.

General section, damage file: when DamageFile is present, resolve the .ini with FileFinder against the config path; when the a4 bit-2 parse flag is clear, parse it with VehicleDamageModel into this+6128; store the resolved path (fallback byte_5EA438) via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
General section: normalize range/setting pairs into the output struct via CRTMathHelper_e1f0 for CgRight, CgRear, Wedge, TireCompound, Fuel, NumPitStops and PitStop1/PitStop2/PitStop3.

FrontWing section: read aero parameter vectors (Fwdragparams, Fwliftparams, Fwmaxheight, Fwliftheight, Fwliftsideways, Fwcenter), validate the six damping directions and rotation via VehicleDampingDirectionValidation/ArithmeticComparison_3490, set the this+0x1EC front-wing drag-params-loaded flag when Fwdragparams parses, and normalize Fwrange/Fwsetting into the output struct.
LeftFender section: dispatch to FenderAeroSetupSectionReader for the left fender corner (index 9).
RightFender section: dispatch to FenderAeroSetupSectionReader for the right fender corner (index 10).

RearWing section: read aero parameter vectors (Rwdragparams, Rwliftparams, Rwliftsideways, Rwcenter), validate the six damping directions and rotation via VehicleDampingDirectionValidation/ArithmeticComparison_3490, set the this+0x2F8 rear-wing drag-params-loaded flag when Rwdragparams parses, and normalize Rwrange/Rwsetting into the output struct.

BodyAero section: read body drag/height vectors (Bodydragbase, Bodydragheight, Bodydragheight_0, Bodymaxheight, Bodycenter), validate the six damping directions and rotation via VehicleDampingDirectionValidation/ArithmeticComparison_3490, read radiator and brake-duct lift/drag, and normalize Radiatorrange/Setting and Brakeductrange/Setting into the output struct.

Diffuser section: read base/side-wall/front-height/center vectors (Diffuserbase, Diffuserfronth, Diffusersidewa, Diffusercenter); set the this+0x4D4 diffuser-base-loaded flag when Diffuserbase parses.

Suspension section: resolve the physical model file with FileFinder (extension from off_5D6164) when Physicalmodelf is present; read flags and scalars (Applyslowtofas, Adjustsusprate, Alignwheels, Springbasedant, wheel tracks/bases, anti-sway bars, 3rd-element bump/rebound/bumpstop packs for front and rear) into this fields; mirror Applyslowtofas to a3+6536 and Springbasedant to a3+6537; normalize the full set of range/setting pairs via CRTMathHelper_e1f0 (anti-sway, toe-in, fender flaps, caster, track bars, 3rd-element spring/packer/bump/rebound).

Controls section: read auto up/down-shift, traction control, ABS and brake/steering assist scalars into this fields, then normalize Steerlock, Rearbrake, Brakepressure and Handbrakepressure range/setting pairs into the output struct via CRTMathHelper_e1f0.

Engine section: gate the restrictor-plate filename validity check (StringCopyWithValidation plus sub_588410/sub_587ECE against Restrictorplate, True and the special off value off_5D59D0); when the Normal vs restrictor-plate variant differs, resolve the engine .ini with FileFinder and parse it with EngineSectionParser (suppressed when the a4 bit-2 parse flag is set); run EngineMapSetupFieldDefinitions on every line; afterwards compute the engine-map scale from this+0x674 * this+0x67C * flt_5EA40C * dword_7D0B64 and write a3+6548/6552 (both zero when the product is non-positive).

Driveline section: read clutch, gearbox, differential, wheel-drive and shift scalars; classify WheelDrive (0/1/2 from Front/Four/Rear) into this+0x13C0; resolve GearFile with FileFinder and copy replay/gear state via ReplayStateCopy when the a4 bit-2 parse flag is clear; read ForwardGears into this+0x13C4; count parsed gear settings, mark enabled gear slots in the output struct, and when the parsed-gear count disagrees with ForwardGears resample the gear-ratio table (CRTFtol-based interpolation); normalize final-drive, reverse, per-gear and differential range/setting pairs via CRTMathHelper_e1f0.
Per-wheel sections (Frontleft, Frontright, Rearleft, Rearright): dispatch each corner to PerWheelBrakeSuspensionDataLoader, writing brake/suspension data into the corner blocks rooted at this+0x13D0.

Basic section: write the four basic joint targets (Downforce, Balance, Ride, Gearing) via DynamicsJointSetTargetPosition and, when Custom is present, set the output struct byte a3+6564 from its parsed value.

On success: finalize track configuration with TrackConfig, close the stream via StreamFileTypeCheckWithDispatch, free the resolved path buffer with FreeWrapper_7bcf, and return 0. The function is invoked from six vehicle-configuration consumers during load/init.
